payload.rationale: This document is a Phase 2 E2E test reproducing the missing-id failure pattern — a heading with no id field that must not crash and must produce a valid slug. It directly extends the existing Position_MissingIdentifierResolution (the unplaced position on how identifiers are resolved when submitted without explicit id) and the Narrative_AutonomousIdentifierSynthesisAndFallback (the ingestion pipeline's identifier synthesis and fallback story). I expanded both at witness depth to surface the two expressions already committed — the plain-assertion that the document was submitted without an id and the decision that the pipeline must produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback. I expanded Actor_XenaExpertgh to confirm the voice/provenance of the existing expressions. I expanded PipelineReliability and ReliabilityResilience to give the passes the strata context (fault tolerance, deterministic fallbacks, complete lifecycle execution) that this test document exercises. No thematic areas exist yet (the Thematic door is empty), and no other people or documents are relevant, so no further expansion would be about this document.
